subject: general
question: There are five girls in a group, each having a different height. H is shorter than E only. F is not as tall as P. P is shorter than G. H is taller than G. Who is the shortest among them?
solution:
Given that:-

 
• H is shorter than E only.

E > H > - > - > -

 
• F is not as tall as P. P is shorter than G.

F 
 
• H is taller than G

H>G

 
• Then final arrangement is:-

F 
 
• Thus, F is the shortest person.

Hence, **"option 3"** is the correct answer.
